{{BLP one source|date=May 2023}}
'''Kalle-Antti Suominen''' (born 1964) is a [[Finns|Finnish]] [[physicist]], professor of physics in the department of physics of [[University of Turku]] in [[Finland]], vice-rector for research at the University of Turku, and chair of the physics and astronomy section of the [[Finnish Academy of Science and Letters]].<ref>[http://www.helsinki.fi/~hoyer/symp13/Suominen.html Speaker biography], Randomness and order in the exact sciences 
175th Anniversary Symposium of the Finnish Society of Sciences and Letters, retrieved 2015-06-26.</ref>
